events.body:
## Context

README, CONTRIBUTING and GOVERNANCE tell submitters to create `public/cves/YYYY/BLT-YYYY-DRAFT.json`, but the schema and `scripts/validate_cves.py` only accept `BLT-YYYY-NNNN`, so every draft fails local validation. `build_index.py` would also publish drafts.

## What to do

1. Accept `BLT-YYYY-DRAFT` in `validate_cves.py` (schema-validate with the id pattern relaxed, keep the year/filename checks).
2. Skip DRAFT files in `build_index.py`.
3. Add tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A well-formed draft validates
- [ ] A malformed draft still fails
- [ ] Drafts excluded from index.json/feed.json
- [ ] Tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cve
```

---
